test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

Some journals are novels.

Some novels are broachers.

All broachers are charts.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some charts are novels.

II. Some broachers are journals.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Given:

Statements :

Some journals are novels.

Some novels are broachers.

All broachers are charts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5f29f16cb1a9156067daf53b9ea1c27f46856e55813cdb858655812b9102c90.png] 

Conclusions :

I. Some charts are novels - **True **(Those part of Charts that is Broachers will be definitely Novels)

II. Some broachers are journals - False (There is no definite relation given between Broachers and Journals, so it is possible only)

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
